
RESTORE-RULE
Restore soft-deleted business rule by stable ID (undeletes item and clears deletedAt timestamp)

USAGE
  fspec restore-rule <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Rule ID (stable index from show-work-unit or show-deleted)

OPTIONS
  --ids <ids>
    Restore multiple rules with comma-separated IDs (e.g., "2,5,7")

EXAMPLES
  1. Restore deleted rule with ID 2
  $ fspec restore-rule AUTH-001 2
  ✓ Restored rule from AUTH-001
Rule reappears at index [2] in show-work-unit

  2. Restore multiple rules at once (bulk restore)
  $ fspec restore-rule AUTH-001 --ids 2,5,7
  ✓ Restored 3 rules from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-rule
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec show-deleted
  fspec compact-work-unit

NOTES
  • Uses stable IDs that never shift when items are removed
  • Restoring an already-active item is idempotent (succeeds with message)
  • Non-existent IDs will fail with clear error message
  • Bulk restore validates all IDs before restoring any item
